trello.name: DataBridge Contract Renewal Final Follow-up & Escalation
trello.desc:
Sofia needs to send a final email to the DataBridge account manager today in plain language requesting the revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business (COB).

If they do not reply by Thursday COB, Sofia must escalate the issue to the legal department on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. Do not wait for Ravi's approval to escalate; the condition (no reply by Thursday COB) is the trigger.

trello.name: Security Audit Crypto & Key Management Findings Review
trello.desc:
Sofia needs to message Dana today with the 60-page external security audit report.

Ask Dana to review sections 4 and 6, which cover cryptography and key management findings. Frame the request as coming from Ravi. Ask Dana to send her assessment to the vendor and compliance sync group before the next sync in two weeks. If Dana does not have the bandwidth, let Ravi know so he can escalate to her manager.

trello.name: Update Rebrand FAQ with Logo Decision
trello.desc:
Tomas needs to add a line to the rebrand FAQ stating the final decision that the logo will stay as is and only the color palette will be refreshed.

The FAQ line must include a link to the March meeting notes where this decision was originally made. This is to prevent the question from resurfacing every quarter. This task should be completed by the end of this week.
